svg.title: Sixty-four frames miss a collision
svg.desc: Actual edited timed path fitted to one planar crank-rocker. All 64 nominal tool samples miss the one millimetre obstacle by at least 0.751 millimetres, yet the interval checker finds a nominal tool collision between frames 53 and 54. The full mechanism and a separate detail each use equal horizontal and vertical millimetre scales. This diagnostic checks the tool only, with zero dimension tolerance; bars and physical safety are not checked.
svg.text: A real fitted mechanism, checked between playback samples.
Fitted linkage, at a between-frame probe
Interval result: collision, nominal tool only.
Bars excluded; zero dimensional tolerance in this diagnostic.
Diamond: midpoint; red circle: stored witness.
